description: This Java class 'StartChildActor' is a message used in an actor-based system (likely Akka). It encapsulates the properties and name needed to start a new actor as a child within an actor system. The class is immutable, contains getters, overridden equals, hashCode, and toString methods, and is intended for local use within an actor context.
